risks.risk: Panel wattage/cell count may not match the stated 650W/144-cell (could be lower-rated or different configuration).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel nameplate/serial label showing brand, model, rated wattage (W), and cell count (or a photo of the full spec sticker).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used, unverified-rated solar panel (worst case: treat as lower output than claimed).

risks.risk: Battery condition/capacity may be overstated ("new" and "8 hours" may not reflect real usable capacity under load).
risks.proof: Photos of the battery label/spec (Ah/Wh, voltage), plus a short video showing the battery connected to a known load with runtime measurement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a battery with unknown capacity (worst case: assume reduced/uncertain performance).

risks.risk: Possible mismatch in quantity: photo shows more than one panel, but seller text mentions a single 650W panel; total system value depends on how many panels are included.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full set laid out with a count (or a screenshot listing quantity of panels and battery model/quantity).
risks.if_unproven: Price for the minimum implied item set (worst case: assume fewer panels than shown).

risks.risk: Shipping/installation readiness issues (connectors, junction box condition, cracked glass, water ingress) not visible from this angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each panel’s junction box, connector type, and edges/corners (and a backsheet photo if possible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as panels needing inspection/possible minor defects (worst case: assume at least one panel may be faulty).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the panel nameplate/spec sticker (brand/model, rated watts, cell count, serial).
Photos of the battery label/spec (voltage and capacity in Ah/Wh) and the battery itself (not just panels).
A runtime test: battery connected to a known load with measured runtime (or a meter reading) to support the "8 hours" claim.
A full-set photo showing the exact number of panels included and the exact battery quantity/model.
response.reason: From photo 0, the item type (solar panels) is visible, but the key pricing drivers (exact rated wattage/cell count, brand/model, and the battery details) are not readable or shown. Without those, a worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
